        # Parse back based on format
        if result.format_used == NativeTimestampFormat.ISO_8601:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(
                result.native_value.replace("Z", "+00:00")
            )
        elif result.format_used in (
            NativeTimestampFormat.UNIX_EPOCH_STRING,
            NativeTimestampFormat.UNIX_EPOCH_INT,

        )
